title: Extra hours are not charged in the estimate
steps: Local, Malleshwaram, Sedan, 2 pax; search with 8 hrs and with 10 hrs (all else identical)
expected: 10 hrs = 8Hr/80Km package + 2 × Extra Hour Charge (₹400/hr) = ₹5,300
actual: Both estimates ₹4,500; the extra-hour charge from the Fare Breakup is not applied

title: Final drop is the last destination instead of the pickup when 'Drop at different location' is OFF
steps: Outstation, Whitefield → Mysuru, Different drop OFF, search
expected: Drop Address = Whitefield (round trip back to pickup, per test data)
actual: Drop Address = Mysuru (trip ends at the destination)

title: SUV listed with 0 seats and can never be booked
steps: Any search → SUV (LSUV) card → Book This Vehicle with 5 pax
expected: SUV shows its seating capacity and can be booked
actual: Card shows 0 Seater; selection always triggers 'Passenger Capacity Not Complete!'

title: Passengers capped at 20 (requirement 1–49)
steps: Transfer → Point To Point, enter 21 or 49 passengers
expected: 1–49 accepted (ADD-005)
actual: Field max=20; 21 and 49 silently changed to 20 and searched as 20 Pax

title: Eight footer pages have no content
steps: Footer → Offers, Schedules, Refund Status, Agent Registration, Careers, Confirm Phone Booking, Testimonials, FAQ
expected: Each page shows its content
actual: Only a title such as 'Offers Page' is rendered; also linked from the Sitemap

title: Fleet Finder returns 0 vehicles
steps: Our Fleet → Find Vehicles (no filters, or Category = Luxury)
expected: Fleet vehicles listed
actual: '0 Buses Found'

title: Fleet list: Premium and Deluxe categories show 0 vehicles
steps: /fleet-list → click Premium, Deluxe
expected: Premium/Deluxe vehicles (offered in booking results) are listed
actual: Only 3 Luxury Volvos ever shown; Premium and Deluxe show '0 Buses Found'

title: Drop/return-drop time not recalculated when pickup changes, blocking search
steps: P2P: pickup D+3 9:00 AM, then change pickup time to 6:00 PM (or set a later return pickup date)
expected: Drop date/time follows the new pickup
actual: Drop stays at 4:28 PM, giving 'Drop time must be after pickup time' / 'Return drop date cannot be before return pickup date' until edited manually

title: Multi-day trip: today is forced into Selected Dates and cannot be removed
steps: Local → Multi-day ON → add D+5, D+6 → × on today / click today
expected: Any date can be removed (future-only multi-day trips possible)
actual: × works for other dates but not today; today stays selected and morning pickup times are disabled

title: Long-distance 'Local' trip accepted as 80 km package
steps: Local, Drop ON, Whitefield → Mangaluru, 12 hrs
expected: Rejected or re-priced on real distance (~350 km)
actual: 'Local – 12 HR / 80 KM', Distance 80 KM

title: Distance shown incorrectly or vaguely
steps: Outstation Whitefield → Mysuru; Transfer Electronic City → Mysuru; Transfer Whitefield → Whitefield
expected: Real route distance shown consistently
actual: Outstation header '0 KM' while summary shows 600 KM; transfers only show '> 30 KM' (even for same From/To)

title: Identical From and To accepted
steps: P2P From = To = Whitefield → Book Now!
expected: Validation: pickup and drop cannot be the same
actual: Search accepted, 20 vehicles shown, '> 30 KM'

title: Search results lost on page refresh
steps: Run any search → reload /send-inquiry
expected: Results restored, or user returned to the form
actual: '0 Buses Found' with an empty search

title: Agent-only fields shown on the customer support form
steps: Contact Us → Raise a Support Request
expected: Customer form has no internal workflow fields
actual: Assign To, Priority and Status are shown to customers

title: Mobile number (login ID) editable on My Profile
steps: Profile → My Profile → inspect Mobile Number
expected: Login identifier is read-only or changed only via OTP verification
actual: Field is enabled and editable

title: Home: 'Get Your Quote' does nothing; Popular Routes empty
steps: Home → click Get Your Quote; scroll to Popular Routes
expected: CTA takes user to the inquiry form; routes listed
actual: No scroll/navigation/modal; 'No popular routes found'

title: Vehicle details: comfort metrics shown as raw JSON, empty spec fields
steps: Any vehicle → View Full Vehicle Details
expected: Readable values
actual: 'Seat Pitch ({"min":"650","max":"729","current":"690"})'; Suspension/Safety/Transmission blank

title: 'Seat pitch priority' has no visible effect
steps: Results → Comfort Priority → Seat pitch priority
expected: Results reorder/filter
actual: Order unchanged

title: Multi-day trip accepted with a single date
steps: Local → Multi-day ON → keep only today → Book Now!
expected: At least 2 dates required
actual: Accepted as a 1-day trip

title: Hours field accepts 25 without a message
steps: By Hour → Number of Hours = 25
expected: Rejected/flagged at entry (max 24)
actual: 25 retained with no message (Local blocks 25 on submit)

title: Content inconsistencies: social links, support email, founding year
steps: Footer social icons; header/footer emails; Home vs About
expected: Company profiles, one support email, one founding year
actual: Icons open facebook.com/, instagram.com/ etc. (no profile); two different emails; Home 'since 1997' vs About 'since 2005'
